text:
Maya (Marketing): New launch post draft ready for quick pass. Key asks: tighten hero, confirm benchmark copy, lock webinar slot, and inbound tracking. Doc: https://docs.google.com/d/LaunchDraft2

Jules (Content): Reading now. Can we keep hero factual? no "game-changing" language.

Ravi (Growth): Bench number idea: 'median 1.8x cost reduction' vs 'up to 2x' which is punchier. Which do we prefer? Need citation.

Maya (Marketing): Use 'Up to 2x lower inference cost at production scale' on hero, and include a footnote linking to methodology.

Tess (Legal): Change to 'Up to 2x lower inference cost' (lowercase) and add a clear footnote with methodology link. Avoid implying guaranteed savings.

Jules (Content): I'll update hero and add a parenthetical link to the appendix. Also drafting social variants and meta description.

Nora (Events): Webinar: propose June 16, 11am PT (45 min). Who's presenting? Need speaker bio + deck.

Ravi (Growth): I can present routing demo. Availability check: June 16 works. I'll keep demo tight ~15min.

calendar-bot: Event created — "Optimize Launch Webinar" June 16 11:00 PT.

Omar (Ops): HubSpot tags: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_jun2026. Map to list 112233. Confirm fields: company_size, primary_use_case, region.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks Omar. Add UTM example to doc so CTAs use consistent params.

Jules (Content): CTAs set: primary 'Register for demo', secondary 'Start a dedicated trial'. Social short: 'See cost-saving inference in action'. Tess — any legal flags in social?

Tess (Legal): Remove superlatives from social copy. Also any customer quotes must be signed off. Mark quotes needing approval in yellow.

Jules (Content): Done. Two quotes flagged. Email template for approvals added to doc.

Nora (Events): Sent calendar invites, registration cap 400. Will attach deck once Jules uploads. Also added speaker bio placeholder for Ravi.

Ravi (Growth): Bio: 'Ravi Kapoor, Lead Growth — previously on infra at Nimbus, focuses on production inference economics.' Use that.

Omar (Ops): I'll create HubSpot automation to tag registrants and route to SDR Queue B. Will confirm when live. Automation ETA: 24 hours.

Maya (Marketing): Publish target June 14 8am PT. Checklist: legal done, quotes approved/flagged, hubspot mapping live, deck attached. React :white_check_mark: when ready.

Tess (Legal): Legal edits complete. Footnote added.

Jules (Content): 1 quote approved, 1 pending outreach.

Omar (Ops): HubSpot automation live. Routing to SDR Queue B and list 112233 confirmed.

Nora (Events): Deck uploaded and pinned to registration confirmation. Rehearsal scheduled June 15 2pm PT. calendar-bot: Reminder set.

Maya (Marketing): Great — proceeding to schedule publish. If the final quote doesn't clear, we'll anonymize the snippet. Thanks all.
